name: elastic
description: Elastic ingest-pipeline logic compiled to native Rust: field extraction, mutation and enrichment applied per event, selected by source name.

fields.name: source.name
fields.description: Which compiled transform to apply, e.g. filebeat.okta.default.

fields.name: source.envelope
fields.description: How the payload is wrapped on the way in. `syslog` reads dfe-receiver's output and applies only to device sources.
